attribution.title: Sierra Nevada aerial
attribution.author: Jeffrey Pang from Pittsburgh, PA, USA
attribution.description: North-northwest view of the Mills Creek cirque (center) in the Sierra National Forest near the midpoint of the Sierra Crest, which extends along the cirque's southeast corner (right) at Mounts Abbot and Mills northward from La Salle Lake (bottom, partially shadowed), the image's centerline is through the south side of the cirque between Mounts Hilgard (left, casting shadow w/ sunlit streak) and Gabb (right of centerline), then north of the cirque along the Sierra Crest's Red and White and Red Slate mountains (right of centerline). The crest extends northwest to Mammoth Crest and Mammoth Mountain and then west of Mono Lake (top, blue) in the north, e.g., across Tioga Pass west of the Wheeler Crest. Between the cirque and Mono Lake is Crowley Lake (white, right of centerline).
